closed_blockers.finding: Unconditional cancellation after releasing the barrier on the successful two-ready path can cancel both OpenContext operations before the intended real initializer race and make unique-winner assertion artificial.
closed_blockers.required_change: On normal two-ready path release barrier and await actual results without immediate cancel. Cancel on premature return/failure/deadline or after both results finish. Define success-result wait and cleanup budgets explicitly; cleanup budget must not extend the20s ready gate.

closed_blockers.finding: Bounded join and guaranteed all-path worker/pool cleanup are not equivalent. If a worker outlives cleanup deadline, it may later return a DB after the test receiver exits and TempDir cleanup begins. Current plan does not assign ownership for that late DB.
closed_blockers.required_change: Specify ownership protocol for every nonnil pool, including late results, without blocking worker sends. Prefer worker-owned deferred pool close with coordinated validation release, or explicit acknowledged transfer plus abandoned-result cleanup. Register cleanup before assertions; do not call require/Fatal while unregistered pools or workers remain. On join timeout report cleanup_incomplete honestly, retain owned path for diagnosis or isolate uninterruptible worker in an owned child; do not claim all resources joined.

implementation_checklist.detail: Use worker-tagged ready/result records, retain early result already received, collect each worker exactly once. One monotonic timer/deadline should govern whole ready wait instead of resetting20s per notification; state whether this intentionally tightens existing per-iteration implementation.

Stage summaries are read by parent while workers run; use mutex or immutable buffered events, a per-worker cap and copy snapshot. Observer must not call testing Fatal/require or block sending telemetry. Barrier release must be once-only.

Specify numeric bounded cleanup deadline and cancellation behavior while barrier-blocked. Classify errors with fixed code/errors.Is plus stage; do not print raw error strings that could contain DB paths/SQL. Reopen/schema assertions also need owned-pool cleanup registered before assertions.

final_followup.result: Latest on-disk six constraints close cancellation-order and pool-ownership blockers.
confirmed: Single20s ready deadline; independent20s result watchdog does not extend readiness gate.

Worker owns and closes pool, validates schema without testing API, then returns pure summary. No late bare DB transfer.

Per-worker stage summaries mutex protected and fixed error classification avoids path/SQL leakage.
Winner/loser/schema/reopen checks preserved and original failure retained; root cause remains unknown.
code_review_checks: Use once-only barrier close; worker-ID ready/result tracking must consume early result exactly once.
Result sends must stay nonblocking after parent stops waiting (capacity2 for one terminal summary per worker); retain close errors distinctly.
No require/schemaSnapshot(t,...) in worker. Worker cleanup must cover any nonnil DB even with an error or local validation failure.
Interpret join-after-testing restriction as parent-only diagnostics after join attempt; incomplete join needs safe fixed reporting, no worker testing API.
Reopen pool Close must precede final directory removal; no success cleanup deletion while reopened handle remains alive.
